context: Two newsroom editors plan a media-comparison segment
purpose: Teach: 講談社/毎日新聞/読売新聞/一流/黒人/反日/シンポジウム/セクション

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 次の特集セクション、メディア比較の企画でいきたいんですけど、講談社の編集者にも声をかけてみました。
lines.en: For the next feature section, I'd like to go with the media comparison plan, and I've reached out to a Kodansha editor as well.
lines.style: Casual-polite pitch from junior editor, slightly excited but professional tone

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいね。やっぱり毎日新聞と読売新聞、両紙の編集委員を呼ばないと話にならないよ。
lines.en: Sounds good. We really can't have a serious discussion without inviting editorial board members from both Mainichi and Yomiuri.
lines.style: Decisive senior tone, leaning forward, mid-tempo and matter-of-fact

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ですよね。一流の論客を揃えて、ちゃんとしたシンポジウム形式にしたら視聴率も期待できそうです。
lines.en: Right? If we line up top-tier commentators and make it a proper symposium format, we can expect decent ratings too.
lines.style: Enthusiastic agreement, building momentum, slightly hopeful pitch

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ただ、扱うテーマが微妙でね。海外メディアの黒人記者の視点も入れたいけど、反日報道の話題に踏み込むと炎上しかねない。
lines.en: However, the subject matter is delicate. I want to include the perspective of a Black reporter from foreign media, but if we touch on anti-Japan coverage it could blow up.
lines.style: Cautious, measured, brow-furrowed concern from experienced editor

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そこは構成台本で慎重に詰めます。論点を整理して、感情論にならないよう司会者にも事前に共有しておきます。
lines.en: I'll work that out carefully in the script. I'll organize the talking points and brief the moderator in advance so it doesn't slide into pure emotion.
lines.style: Reassuring, problem-solving, taking responsibility with clear next steps

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 助かる。あと、報道セクションの部長にも一応根回ししといて。
lines.en: That helps. Also, give the head of the news section a heads-up just in case.
lines.style: Brief, practical instruction, trusting and collegial

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解です。今日の夕方までに企画書まとめて、関係各所にメールしておきます。
lines.en: Got it. I'll finalize the proposal by this evening and email it to all the relevant parties.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment, motivated and ready to execute

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん、頼んだ。これがうまくいけば、うちの番組の格も一段上がるはずだから。
lines.en: Yeah, I'm counting on you. If this goes well, our show's prestige should jump up a notch.
lines.style: Encouraging, looking-ahead, quiet confidence from the boss
